attributes.name: Paracletus
attributes.powers:
Before you act, choose a card that has the Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Electricity, Fire, or Poison trait and roll 1d6. On a 1 or 2, bury that card. On a 3 or 4, discard it.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.
